title: Genesis 3:13-14 — the serpent deceived me; the serpent is cursed
summary: Genesis 3:13-14 in English: the LORD God asks the woman what she has done, she answers that the serpent deceived her, and the LORD God curses the serpent above all cattle and beasts, to go on its belly and eat dust. Verse 15 is named in the header but not yet shown.

text.text: 13 Then the LORD God said to the woman, “What is this you have done?” And the woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”

14 The LORD God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, Cursed are you more than all cattle, And more than every beast of the field; On your belly you will go, And dust you will eat all the days of your life;
